ramen.title: Food story
ramen.fill: Tell the story of how ramen went from cheap late-night street food to a global obsession — a little history, a lot of steaming, mouth-watering bowls. A 60-second Douyin video. Land it: it's comfort in a bowl, and the whole world is hooked.

honey.title: Did you know
honey.fill: How is honey actually made? Follow it from flower to jar — bees gathering nectar, the buzzing hive, honeycomb dripping gold. A satisfying, surprising 45-second Douyin. Land it: it takes a whole hive to make one spoonful.

cats.title: Animal facts
cats.fill: Why do cats purr? It's weirder than you think — cats also purr when they're scared or hurt, and the low vibration may help heal their bones. A fun, surprising 40-second TikTok. Land it: your cat is a tiny self-repair machine.

beijing.title: Travel guide
beijing.fill: 5 underrated things to do in Beijing that most tourists skip — hidden viewpoints, tiny family-run food spots, a sunset tram ride. Make it a dreamy but fast-paced 45-second TikTok. The one thing to land: save this for your trip.

hook.title: 3-second hook
hook.fill: Open with a 3-second pattern interrupt: one counter-intuitive claim slammed in kinetic type, then one instantly usable tip. Vertical 9:16, ~20s Douyin, kinetic typography, hard CTA at the end: like & save.

list.title: List punch
list.fill: A vertical checklist: 3 phone settings to turn off tonight — each line gets a crisp check-off beat. ~28s Douyin. Land it: do these three before bed.

loop.title: Loop quote
loop.fill: A loopable vertical quote film: slam one punchy line word-by-word with kinetic type and a gentle camera push. ~12–15s TikTok loop. Land it: the line itself is the product.

draw.title: Stroke-draw my mark
draw.fill: I have a line-art SVG logo. Open with a minimal geometric tease, then an accent-color bounce with a path trail, then stroke-draw the mark with overshoot settle. About 6–8s, refined, dark grain background. Mark is the hero — no explainer captions.

icon.title: Bounce in my icon
icon.fill: I have a compact icon/badge SVG logo. Geometric tease, accent bounce-in, scale overshoot and a secondary settle bounce with a hotspot glow. About 5–7s, bold energy. Mark only, no copy.

build.title: Assemble my wordmark
build.fill: I have a multi-part/wordmark SVG logo. After a geometric guide, assemble letter-by-letter or shape-by-shape, overshoot into the lockup, optional one-line URL. About 6–8s, precise. No VO, no explainer captions.

principles.title: 12 principles reel
principles.fill: Make a ~14s 16:9 motion showreel branded “Studio”. Six chapters: squash & stretch, kinetic type, systems & stagger, radial orbit, shatter, end lockup. High-contrast red/white/black, no VO, tiny HUD ok.

brand.title: Brand-color MG reel
brand.fill: Build a ~14s MG showreel in my brand colors: six technique chapters (squash / kinetic / stagger grid / radial type / shatter / lockup), end on my brand name. No VO, full-bleed vector motion.

dark.title: Dark tech reel
dark.fill: Deep black, fine grain, orange-red accents. ~15s showreel covering squash, kinetic slam, stagger grid, radial orbit, shatter, and lockup. No VO — portfolio opener energy.

three.title: 3 takeaways from an article
three.fill: Read this article and produce a short, brand-style video that distills its three biggest takeaways. Carry each point with an animated diagram, keep a confident and steady voice-over rhythm, use clean typography with a single accent color, and end on one summary card. Use this source: https://www.xxx.com/...

chapters.title: Chaptered deep dive
chapters.fill: Turn this article into a 75-second chaptered explainer in a 16:9 frame. Open with a one-line thesis, then walk each section as its own chapter with a small progress indicator, schematic diagrams that build step by step, and smooth transitions between chapters. Measured, documentary-style pacing suited to a voice-over. Use this source: https://www.xxx.com/...

promo.title: Product pitch
promo.fill: Make a ~45s vertical remix from the footage folder: open with a pain point, show how the product fixes it, end with a clear CTA. Spoken, natural VO — not ad-speak.

story.title: Story VO
story.fill: Build a ~60s story remix: hook → details → twist or payoff. One idea per VO line; cuts follow the narration.

tips.title: Tips list
tips.fill: A ~40s tips remix: three actionable tips, one spoken line each. Vertical, made for a quick Douyin scroll.
